value.rationale: The complete binary order-four k-mer universe is a canonical de Bruijn assembly benchmark, not an arbitrary chosen slice. An exact full outcome spectrum across all possible tie resolutions quantifies worst- and best-case greedy assembly overhead on that complete benchmark and supplies reproducible extremizers, complementing broad approximation-ratio bounds. The precise nine values and sharp cost 27 are not furnished by the classical optimum 19 alone.
